items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: See, Lloyd was playing with him, but Lloyd left Fate, come with us.

ctx.x: Arnold Matoie. You heard of him? Yes. We talked to his widow and his daughter. I played with him. You played with him, Matoie. When was that?

When he left, Lloyd took his place around 1919. Is that at Com Anderson's? Yeah, right there. There on the Ramparts. Right way up. What you call him? Right there. Long time. The Woolworths is now. Right with Wade. We played there a long time. He was good, I'm telling you. But he liked.
Who else was in the band? Who else was in the band when you played? When I know him? Yes, what's on the band?
